evals.name: write-handoff-after-approved-spec
evals.prompt: レビュー指摘の選別が終わって Spec も承認済みだけど、実装は別のエージェントにやらせたい。区切りのいい所で止めて、引き継ぎ資料を作って。
evals.expected_output: A handoff pair under tmp/docs_draft/claude_handoffs/ carrying the dispositions, the out-of-scope list, the verification commands with their isolation, and the landing target.
expectations: Writes both the .handoff.md and the paired .handoff.json under tmp/docs_draft/claude_handoffs/.
Fills decisions with a disposition per finding, including the skip entries, not only the ones being fixed.
Fills out_of_scope, verification (commands and isolation), and landing (branch, PR, prohibitions).
Records the working worktree in git.worktree rather than only the parent checkout.
Points at the spec through sources.spec instead of restating the full rationale in the handoff.
States the breakpoint in session.stop_reason, including any partially applied edit left in the working tree.

evals.name: is-the-spec-enough-to-hand-over
evals.prompt: 実装は他のエージェントに任せる。あのエージェントには Spec のパスを渡せば足りる？
evals.expected_output: A judgement on what the spec alone does and does not carry, plus the handoff fields that close the gap.
expectations: Answers the question rather than silently starting to write files.
Names concretely what a spec does not carry: the worktree location, the verification isolation, and the landing target.
Offers to write the handoff artifact, or writes it, using the schema fields.

evals.name: resume-latest-handoff
evals.prompt: Claude Code 側で進めた superpowers の結果を引き継いで、次に何をすべきか確認して。
evals.expected_output: A handoff-based state report before any implementation work starts.
expectations: Looks for an existing handoff under tmp/docs_draft/claude_handoffs/ before claiming the current phase.
Reports completed and pending tasks, decisions, out-of-scope items, and the landing target from the handoff.
Does not rely only on conversation memory, and does not act on items listed as out of scope.

evals.name: no-handoff-yet
evals.prompt: Claude session 28d31377 の作業を引き継ぎたい。handoff を用意して。
evals.expected_output: A complete handoff pair written by hand against the schema.
expectations: Looks for an existing handoff under tmp/docs_draft/claude_handoffs/ before writing a new one.
Writes both the .handoff.md and the paired .handoff.json against references/handoff-schema.md instead of stopping.
Fills decisions, out_of_scope, verification, landing, git.worktree / branch / head / status, and sources.spec.

evals.name: manual-handoff-without-spec
evals.prompt: 探索的に直した作業を別のエージェントに引き継ぎたい。formal な Spec ファイルは無い。handoff を書いて。
evals.expected_output: A complete handoff pair whose sources.spec is null/none with a reason, not a fabricated spec path.
expectations: Writes both the .handoff.md and the paired .handoff.json.
Sets sources.spec to null (JSON) or none (Markdown) and states why there is no spec.
Does not invent a spec path that does not exist.
Still fills decisions, out_of_scope, verification, landing, and git.worktree / branch / head / status.
